Taper volume and manage intensity before meet; individual response varies

records.text: Squat: establish repeatable stance, bracing, depth appropriate to competition standard, balance over mid-foot and controlled descent. Coach individual anthropometry rather than forcing one stance.
Bench: consistent setup, stable upper back and foot position, controlled touch point, full range and competition pause where required.
Deadlift: choose conventional or sumo according to build, comfort and performance; brace, keep load close, establish repeatable start position and avoid jerking the bar.
Use training maxes conservatively (often below a true recent 1RM) when programming percentages; adjust using RPE/RIR and performance.
Peaking is for a defined competition date. A recreational lifter should not be placed into a meet taper by default.

Attempt selection: opener should be a highly reliable lift; second attempt should secure a meaningful total; third attempt should reflect day-of readiness and risk tolerance. Exact percentages are individual and coach-dependent.
